integrity: Proof uses direct enumeration of all 120 orders, eight exact free-face cancellations, and signed chain traces; an executable standard-library checker is embedded. This is a self-review only, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Unfilled one-dimensional five-vertex house graph only; full strong complex, not pure or ordinary. Reflection eigenspaces are over the rationals; no integral splitting asserted. Bibliographic completeness is not guaranteed.
title: The strong Morse complex of the house graph: nine circles and reflection symmetry
